NOTIFICATION
anchayayts, Rural Housing and Rural Development Department
Sach ivalaya, Gandhinagar.
Dated the 21th January, 201,4.
Gujarat 
No. KP/ 10 of 2014 /PRR/Lo2ota/77IKH:- tn exercise of the powers conferred by
Panchayats
Act' 1993' section 227 read with sub-section (5) of section 274 of the Gujarat panchayats
Act, L993 (Guj. 18 of 1993), the Government of Gujarat hereby makes the
following rules further to amend the MultiPurpose Health Worker (Male), Class
lll, (Panchayat Service) Recruitment Rules, ZO1,L, namely:_
1. 
These rules may be called the MultiPurpose Health Worker (Male), Class lll,
{Panchayat Service) Recruitment (Amendment) Rules, ZOL4.
2. 
ln the MultiPurpose Health Worker (Male), Class lll, Recruitment Rules, 201.L, in
rule 3, for the clauses (a) and proviso thereunder, the following shall be substituted,
namely :-
"(a) not be less than j.8 years of age and not be more than 29 years of age:
Provided that the upper age limit shall not be applicable in case of a candidate who
is working as a Multi Purpose Health Worker (Male), Class lll, in the panchayat Service
either on contract basis on fixed pay or on adhoc basis in regular pay scale on the date of
publication of this notification and who possesses the qualiflcations as prescribed in
clauses (b), (c) and (d) of this rule and who offers his candidature in respect of
advertisement which may be published in the year 201,4;,,.
By order and in the name of the Governor of Gujarat,
B**6f,
fuy
-v
(8,R. rb h.e3-* )
Under Secretary to Government.
